findings: New save_lr_selection requires all nine completed serial dispatch receipts and replays independent frozen requests, producer/tensor/resource/validation audits, original pilot cleanup history and full future storage before persisting a choice. It writes an immutable preselection review first, then the three-rate map selected by minimum H200 CE with lower-LR ties, then repeats full stage audits and storage checks and publishes a finished-guard-bound completion receipt.

The persisted choice is bound to the full LR stage and exact proposed losing-screen manifest. In the synthetic panel this identifies12 candidate files; all18 raw/H200 screening files remain unchanged. No deletion, rank request, training, promotion or next-stage permission occurs. A choice file without its final completion receipt cannot authorize the transition.

Read-only verification binds the historical finished selection guard, attempt and preselection provenance, recomputes the current complete stage/selection/storage and validates the saved original stage manifest. It accepts only the exact idle pre-cleanup inventory. After actual deletion a separate reviewed history consumer is required; missing tensors are not silently excused.

All14 negative cases passed: incomplete0/8-screen stages, changed checkpoints/numerical evidence/dispatch/tensor audits, space loss, choice/stage/completion publication failure, rewritten selection/stage/guard and premature rank output. The positive case reached its final assertion but referenced a nonexistent storage field name. Corrected the test to cleanup_boundaries_verified; the positive case plus rule and stage-audit dependencies then passed66 tests in15.79s. Production code was unchanged after the first test run; original failure log/guard retained.

The synthetic complete nine-screen campaign occupied941073 metadata bytes in the observed initial success fixture, below its2MiB metadata group cap. This fixture uses simplified configs/source maps and does not prove the eventual full frozen metadata footprint fits. Exact full-config/source/receipt accounting remains a prelaunch requirement.
limitations: Scientific requests, numerical records, checkpoint payloads, validation values and child PIDs are synthetic; child execution is mocked. These tests establish selection/controller semantics, not model quality, numerical recurrence correctness or measured MPS feasibility.

LR boundary deletion and post-cleanup history integration, rank/fresh transitions and inference orchestration remain unfinished. Actual nine numerical/input cases and measured pilots remain unresolved. The failed combined numerical fixture stays closed, as do historical campaigns.

No research training/MPS launch, research checkpoint deletion, failed combined numerical retry, closed-controller rerun or holdout evaluation occurred. The27-trajectory campaign remains unfrozen and all resource, storage and prospective quality rules are unchanged.
